messages:
maya: quick check — vendor reports OOMs in eu-west1 burst-gpu pool during our nightly evals. Need 4 GPUs 00:30-02:30 UTC. @priya @henry

priya: which GPUs? H100 preferred. Is this burst-gpu or dedicated-spot?

maya: burst-gpu. telemetry shows kv_cache eviction spikes at ~00:28. quick snippet to repro: `curl -s https://telemetry.internal/api/v1/metrics?query=oom_kv_cache%7Bregion%3D%22eu-west1%22%7D | jq .`

henry: I can flip kv_cache.max_entries down to 300k for the evals cluster. Command: `infractl patch cluster=evals --set kv_cache.max_entries=300000`. rollback ready (set back to 1_000_000) if any regressions.

vendor-ops: vendor here — can offer 2xA100 immediate and 1xH100 if you confirm by 21:00 UTC. Need manifest + billing tag to hold.

maya: manifest: tenant=redwood-demo-d3f, workload=nightly-evals, start=2026-04-05T00:30Z, duration=2h, gpu_mix=2xA100+2xH100 (prefer H100s). billing tag RED-EVAL-7

capacity-bot: Tentative hold created for 2026-04-05 00:30-02:30 UTC — 2 A100 + 1 H100 (eu-west1). Hold expires 2026-04-04 21:00 UTC if not confirmed.

priya: opened procurement ticket PROJ-9012 and assigned to @maya. please confirm by 20:45 UTC to keep hold.

henry: left a short CR comment on the infra repo for the kv_cache change. maya, can you lgtm if perf run looks good?

maya: will run a quick perf and confirm by 20:30 UTC. thanks all.
